_about: Parts for `pocket new --random`: one land, sometimes who lives there and a force, a mood and a start. `has` tags what a part brings; a part with `needs` is only picked when they are all there, one with `avoid` never when any is.

a river country where towns stand on stilts

red craggy hills with houses built against the slopes
a quiet farmland of hedgerows, mills and market days

who.text: hill folk and valley folk who don't trust each other
gentle giants who keep to the high ground
elves in the woods and humans in the fields
lizard folk of the water and the shore
a dragon that everyone pretends is not there
griffins that some families have learned to ride
shepherds and the wolves that follow their flocks
tall heron people who speak only in sounds
foxes as big as horses, clever but wordless

force.text: curses spread by touch and blacken what they reach
holy springs make what is dipped in them glow and never break
living things grow at night and shrink by day
iron rusts and crumbles in water
rot eats wood until it breaks

mood.text: green and wet after the rains

a new house is going up, and everyone is helping
